name: bio
title: Biology
summary: Sequence search and alignment, profile models, phylogenetic trees, tools for sequencing reads and variants, and single-cell analysis. No sequence databases are included: bring the sequences you need.

tools.name: blast+
tools.does: sequence similarity search against a database you build from your own FASTA file
tools.usage: makeblastdb -in db.fa -dbtype nucl -out db; blastn -query q.fa -db db -outfmt 6
tools.check:
printf '>a
ACGTACGTACGTACGTTTGACCA
' > db.fa; makeblastdb -in db.fa -dbtype nucl -out db >/dev/null; printf '>q
ACGTACGTACGTACGTTTGACCA
' > q.fa; blastn -query q.fa -db db -outfmt '6 sseqid pident' -word_size 7

tools.name: mafft, muscle, clustalo
tools.does: multiple sequence alignment: lines up several DNA or protein sequences against each other

tools.name: hmmer
tools.does: profile hidden Markov models: build a profile from an alignment and search sequences with it
tools.usage: hmmbuild fam.hmm aligned.fa; hmmsearch fam.hmm seqs.fa

tools.name: iqtree, fasttree
tools.does: phylogenetic trees by maximum likelihood, with model selection and bootstrap support
tools.usage: iqtree -s aligned.fa -m MFP -bb 1000   |   FastTree -nt aligned.fa > tree.nwk

tools.name: samtools, bcftools, bedtools
tools.does: sequencing reads, variants and genome intervals: sort, index, filter, call, intersect
tools.usage: samtools sort in.bam -o out.bam; bcftools view in.vcf.gz; bedtools intersect -a a.bed -b b.bed

tools.name: minimap2, seqtk
tools.does: aligns long reads or assemblies to a reference (minimap2); quick FASTA and FASTQ manipulation (seqtk)

tools.name: scanpy
tools.does: single-cell gene-expression analysis: quality control, clustering, marker genes, trajectories
tools.check: python -c "import scanpy, anndata, numpy; a=anndata.AnnData(numpy.ones((3,2))); print('cells', a.n_obs)"

tools.name: pysam, dendropy
tools.does: reads and variants from Python (pysam); phylogenetic trees from Python (dendropy)
tools.check: python -c "import pysam, dendropy; t=dendropy.Tree.get(data='((a,b),c);', schema='newick'); print('leaves', len(t.leaf_nodes()))"
